messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands still, then raises both arms overhead and performs a brief dance-like movement before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"Static, full-body shot at a slight low angle, keeping the subject centered.","clothing":"White tank top with a pink and yellow tie-dye pattern, pink shorts with white trim, and red slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"White (from the head wrap); natural hair color is not visible.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair covered by a white head wrap or cap.","identity":"A 3D-rendered, muscular Black man with a short beard, shown in full body.","scene":"A cobblestone street in front of ornate, old-style European buildings with shopfronts and a black lamppost."},"uncertain":["hair_color","The exact location or city of the street setting."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from an underpass/road with railings, trees, and a crane to a cobblestone street in front of ornate old-style European buildings with shopfronts and a lamppost, matching the reference. The person remains the same 3D-rendered muscular Black man in the same white head wrap, tie-dye tank top, pink shorts, and red shoes, performing the same standing-to-dance sequence in a similar static full-body framing.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference cobblestone European street setting, placing the person there while retaining identity, appearance, expression, action, camera framing, and movement, with only environment and lighting changed.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was preserved exactly across all frames.
unexpected_changes: Lighting on the person changed from warm directional sunlight to flatter, cooler ambient street lighting, as expected for the new environment.
